system.name: DapperFL
system.one_liner: A heterogeneous federated learning framework with model fusion pruning and domain adaptive regularization for edge devices; the figure motivates it.

content.variant_note: a server band above three device cards joined by numbered solid down arrows and dotted up arrows, one federated round with a failed device and two different data domains
content.argues: In federated learning on edge devices, a resource-limited device that times out and clients holding data from different domains degrade the aggregated global model.
content.subject: one federated round: server, aggregated global model, three heterogeneous devices with local data, one timeout, falling accuracy on two domains

lessons.what_to_learn: A motivation figure can show the problem as one numbered round: a server band over client cards, a missing return arrow and a red tag on the failed client, and stacked thumbnails that differ per client to show data shift.
lessons.suits: motivation figures for federated or distributed learning where system heterogeneity and data heterogeneity must appear in one picture.

evidence: Device 1, with stringent resource constraints, fails to complete its model update within the maximum allowed time.
Devices 2 and 3 collect data from different domains, leading to diverse local models.
A motivational example of DapperFL with heterogeneous devices and multiple domains.

summary: DapperFL is a heterogeneous federated learning framework, and Figure 1 is its motivational example drawn as one communication round. A light-blue band holds the central server, the aggregated global model as a network glyph, and two red falling-accuracy icons for domains 2 and 3 above the red words Global model performance degradation. Below, three lilac cards for a car, a phone and a camera each receive the global model by a numbered solid arrow (1), do a local update (2) and return the local model by a dotted arrow (3). Device 1 shows a red Update timeout and returns nothing; Devices 2 and 3 hold stacked photo thumbnails from different domains.
summary_zh: DapperFL 的动机图画出一轮联邦学习：浅蓝服务器带聚合后的全局模型和红色的精度下降提示，下方车、手机、摄像头三张设备卡，编号箭头表示下发、本地更新、回传、聚合；设备 1 超时没有回传，设备 2、3 的数据来自不同域。
notes: Prior kinds kept, with worked-walkthrough added for the numbered round. All text is outlined, so the strings were read from the picture. The medium of the icons is a guess (vector). The drawn content spans only x 79-317 of a 399 pt canvas.
